newsitem.title: KENYA: Poor quality on offer drags down Kenyan coffee.
newsitem.headline: Poor quality on offer drags down Kenyan coffee.

text.p: Coffee prices eased on Tuesday at Kenya's weekly auction in line with the poor quality on offer and a fall in the New York terminal market, auction officials said.
They said bidding was very selective. "We're getting the tail end of the (main) crop, very poor quality," a trader said.
Grade ABs averaged $428 per 50 kg, compared to $439 last week, while grade AAs sold at $438 from $451.
The Coffee Board of Kenya said it sold 35,027 60-kg bags on offer, compared to 35,474 bags sold last week.
